breakdown.description: Unit inconsistency: particle diameter given in mm is substituted as meters, producing an orders-of-magnitude error in the Ergun pressure drop.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly converts the particle diameter from 5 mm to 0.005 m, explicitly stating 'dp = 0.005 m (converted from 5 mm)'. It also explicitly rejects the erroneous substitution with the line 'Do not intentionally misuse units by substituting dp = 5 m.' This matches the ground truth's intent of using d_p = 0.005 m in SI units.
